plan: docs/plan-research-coverage-2026-09-23.zh.md section 6.2; ROE was admitted by fundamentals-v1 on 2026-09-24 (IC 0.026, t 3.0, 2024+ 0.021)
selection_disclosure: ROE was chosen after fundamentals-v1, whose cards include 2024-2026, so 2024+ numbers are not out of sample; the judge is the forward holdout (every month after 2026-09-18) and paper trading. ROE exists only for CIK-mapped names (a current-snapshot map: survivors), so the early years are survivor-biased; the matched reference below uses the same universe and the pass rule is judged on 2024+.

admission_rule.rank: the library-v1 rank rule (stable_years AND beats_shuffle AND a T1 or T2 top-30 book positive at 20 bp in the full and 2024+ windows AND max |t| >= 2.5)
admission_rule.beats_reference: in the 2024+ window, the T1 top-30 book held 20 sessions at 20 bp has a higher Sharpe AND a shallower max drawdown than mom_12_1_roe_universe's; the full-window comparison is reported, not required, because of survivor bias
admission_rule.strategy_screen: report the T1 20-session book's 2024+ CAGR and max drawdown against G1 (>= 50%/yr, max DD >= -35%); a pass here only earns a preregistered strategy iteration with the exact anchor window and costs, not a promotion

signals.name: mom_12_1_roe_universe
signals.sql: SELECT d.symbol, d.trade_date, d.momentum_252_21 AS value FROM read_parquet('data/features/daily_broad/*.parquet') d JOIN read_parquet('data/features/sec_fundamentals_daily/*.parquet', union_by_name=true) f USING (symbol, trade_date) WHERE f.roe IS NOT NULL
signals.rationale: reference: 12-1 momentum restricted to names with a usable ROE, so composites are compared on the same universe

signals.name: comp_c4_mom_roe
signals.rationale: momentum plus ROE (quality momentum), equal weight of directional percentile ranks

signals.name: comp_c5_mom_roe_insider

components.sql: SELECT d.symbol, d.trade_date, CASE WHEN i.buyers_60d >= 2 AND i.open_market_buy_count_60d > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS value FROM read_parquet('data/features/daily_broad/*.parquet') d LEFT JOIN read_parquet('data/features/insider_broad/*.parquet', union_by_name=true) i USING (symbol, trade_date)

signals.rationale: C4 plus cluster insider buying in the last 60 sessions (0/1), equal weight
